description: Starts the warranty claims agent for one work order in the GitHub Actions workflow warranty-agent.yml (repo UmashankarKH/rb) and waits up to about 6 minutes for it to finish. Returns status completed with the agent's result (work order status, policy, claim number, claim value, reason, 3C narrative) and the GitHub run link, or status github_failed, not_started or still_running with what is known. Calling it again for the same work order in the same run reuses the first dispatch instead of starting a second one.

wo_id.description: The work order id, such as WO-1001.
